attchmntText: IZMO Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Grant of 116050 Options to eligible employees of the Company.
voiceSummary: IZMO Limited granted 1,16,050 stock options to eligible employees under the ESOP 2013 scheme. The exercise price is Rs. 10 per option. Each option converts into one equity share of Rs. 10. The grant follows the Nomination Remuneration Committee recommendation. The exercise period starts from the vesting date. It expires within sixty months or five years from vesting. The scheme complies with SEBI Share Based Employee Benefits Regulations 2021. Shares arising from exercise rank pari passu with existing equity shares. No options have vested, been exercised, lapsed, or varied. The company filed this disclosure with BSE and NSE under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: IZMO Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 50726 Equity Shares of the Company to eligible employees of the Company under the Employee Stock Option Plan 2013.
voiceSummary: Izmo Limited allotted 50726 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs. 10 each to employees under the ESOP 2013 scheme on November 13, 2026. The allotment was recommended by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. The shares rank pari-passu with existing equity shares. The exercise price per share was Rs. 10 with no premium. There is no lock-in period. The paid-up share capital increased from Rs. 14,98,03,210 to Rs. 15,03,10,470. The total issued equity shares are now 1,50,31,047. The ISIN number is INE848A01014. The distinctive numbers range from 1,49,80,322 to 1,50,31,047. This disclosure complies with Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations and Regulation 10(c) of SEBI SBEB Regulations. The Company Secretary Varun Kumar A S signed the letter.

attchmntText: IZMO Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Izmo Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company allotted 50,726 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs. 10 each to employees under the ESOP 2013 plan. Consequently, paid-up share capital increased from Rs. 14,98,03,210 to Rs. 15,03,10,470. The board also granted 1,16,050 stock options to eligible employees at an exercise price of Rs. 10 per option. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 1,145.64 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 19.58 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 0.13. The statutory auditor noted that sundry debtors, inventories, loans, advances, and current liabilities remain subject to confirmation and reconciliation.

attchmntText: IZMO Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: IZMO Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 1,145.64 lakhs, with a net profit of Rs. 19.58 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 0.13. For the half year, standalone revenue was Rs. 2,139.94 lakhs, and net profit was Rs. 24.65 lakhs. Consolidated revenue for the half year was Rs. 13,173.37 lakhs, with a net profit of Rs. 2,469.44 lakhs. The auditor noted that sundry debtors, inventories, loans, advances, and current liabilities are subject to confirmation and reconciliation. The results are available on the company website.

attchmntText: IZMO Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 03, 2026, titled "izmo Microsystems Successfully Develops and Qualifies Indigenous Pitch Detector for Defence Avionics".
